# PSBM Labs

> PSBM Labs is an independent software and app development studio in Barisal, Bangladesh. Founded by Prothes Barai and Shreyasi Madhu (a husband-and-wife engineering team) with Angkan Barai as co-founder and primary maintainer, it builds mobile apps, web platforms and custom software end to end, and supports them after launch. Clients are served across Bangladesh and internationally.

## Services

- [Services](https://psbmlabs.github.io/services.html): App development, software development, IT consulting, and maintenance & support. Engagement models: fixed-scope build, dedicated build partner, maintenance retainer.
- [Projects & case studies](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects.html): Portfolio of shipped work.
- [Apps](https://psbmlabs.github.io/apps.html): Android apps by PSBM Labs.
- [Open-source Flutter packages](https://psbmlabs.github.io/packages.html): Developer tools published by PSBM Labs.

## People

- [Founders & co-founders](https://psbmlabs.github.io/founders.html): Team overview and company story.
- [Prothes Barai](https://psbmlabs.github.io/prothes.html): Founder and software engineer — Flutter, Kotlin, Firebase, databases, WordPress, AI.
- [Shreyasi Madhu](https://psbmlabs.github.io/shreyasi.html): Co-founder and full-stack developer — HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Django, WordPress, SEO.
- [Angkan Barai](https://psbmlabs.github.io/angkan.html): Co-founder and primary maintainer — monitoring, QA, support.

## Case studies

- [Barisal Health Connect](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/barisal-health-connect.html): Online appointment booking and patient records for small clinics, with automatic SMS confirmations.
- [EduPortal](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/eduportal.html): Role-based school platform for attendance, results and parent notifications.
- [FreightTrack BD](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/freighttrack-bd.html): Live fleet and shipment tracking dashboard with automatic delay flagging.
- [Krishi Bazar](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/krishi-bazar.html): Flutter marketplace connecting farmers directly with buyers, with price alerts and in-app messaging.
- [Notun Khata](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/notun-khata.html): Bangla digital ledger for shop owners with automatic SMS reminders on overdue dues.
- [Setu POS](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/setu-pos.html): Offline-first point-of-sale and inventory app for small retail shops, syncing to Firebase.
- [DailyShield](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/dailyshield.html): A Flutter app that gathers daily protection habits into one place: ten tools, five of which count toward a Shield Score that resets every midnight.
- [Text Studio](https://psbmlabs.github.io/projects/text-studio.html): A Flutter toolbox of 15 text tools — six free and fully offline, nine unlocked with a short ad — built on a reusable ads module that keeps the free tier calm.

## Guides and articles

- [How to Choose the Best Software Company in Barisal](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/best-software-company-in-barisal.html): What to check before hiring a software company in Barisal: portfolio depth, code ownership, communication style, and the red flags worth walking away from.
- [bKash & Nagad Payment Gateway Integration Guide](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/bkash-nagad-payment-gateway-integration.html): A practical guide to integrating bKash and Nagad into apps and websites in Bangladesh — API access, sandbox testing, and reconciliation.
- [Common Mistakes Startups Make When Outsourcing App Development](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/common-mistakes-outsourcing-app-development.html): The recurring mistakes we see startups make when outsourcing app development, and how to avoid them before signing a contract.
- [Building an E-commerce Platform in Bangladesh: A Practical Roadmap](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/ecommerce-platform-roadmap-bangladesh.html): A step-by-step roadmap for building a custom e-commerce platform in Bangladesh — catalog, checkout, payments, delivery, and launch.
- [Firebase vs Custom Backend: What Should Power Your App?](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/firebase-vs-custom-backend.html): How to decide between Firebase and a custom backend for your app — speed, cost, scalability, and control trade-offs explained.
- [Flutter App Development Cost in Bangladesh (2026)](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/flutter-app-development-cost-bangladesh.html): A real-world breakdown of Flutter app development cost in Bangladesh: what drives the price, rough ranges by app type, and how to get an accurate quote.
- [A Founder's Guide to Hiring a Software Development Team in Bangladesh](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/hiring-software-development-team-bangladesh.html): What to check before hiring a software development team in Bangladesh — portfolio depth, code ownership, communication, and pricing structure.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Maintain a Mobile App After Launch?](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/mobile-app-maintenance-cost-after-launch.html): A realistic breakdown of ongoing mobile app maintenance costs after launch — OS updates, bug fixes, hosting, and store compliance.
- [Native vs Flutter: Choosing the Right Mobile Tech Stack](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/native-vs-flutter-mobile-tech-stack.html): How to decide between native (Kotlin/Swift) and Flutter for your mobile app — performance, cost, timeline, and long-term maintenance.
- [How to Build a POS System for Retail Businesses in Bangladesh](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/pos-system-development-retail-bangladesh.html): What goes into building a point-of-sale system for retail in Bangladesh — inventory, offline support, receipts, and local payment methods.
- [Signs Your Business Needs Custom Software (Not Off-the-Shelf)](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/signs-you-need-custom-software.html): How to tell when off-the-shelf software has stopped fitting your business, and when custom software is actually worth the investment.
- [UI/UX Design Fundamentals for Bangladeshi Startups](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/ui-ux-design-fundamentals-bangladeshi-startups.html): Practical UI/UX fundamentals for startups building apps and websites for a Bangladeshi audience — clarity, trust, and local usability habits.
- [Web Application Development Cost in Bangladesh (2026)](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/web-application-development-cost-bangladesh.html): What a custom web application actually costs to build in Bangladesh — pricing by project type, the factors that move the number, and how to budget realistically.
- [WordPress vs Custom Software: Which One Do You Need?](https://psbmlabs.github.io/blog/wordpress-vs-custom-software.html): A practical comparison of WordPress and custom-built software — when each one is the right call, and the signs you've outgrown a template.
